tbesh_html:
Beth-diblathaim = "house of the two fig-cakes"
a place in Moab
Another name of al.mon div.la.ta.ye.mah (עַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה "Almon-diblathaim" H5963)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Beth-Diblathajim, a place East of the Jordan
strongs_1890.derivation: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the dual of H1690 (דְּבֵלָה); house of (the) two figcakes;
